title: CATERPILLAR TO INVEST $1 BILLION IN NORTH CAROLINA TO EXPAND CAT COMPACT MANUFACTURING CAPACITY
text: INVESTMENT STRENGTHENS ABILITY TO SERVE GROWING COMPACT EQUIPMENT CUSTOMER SEGMENT IRVING, TEXAS, SEPT. 30, 2026 /PRNEWSWIRE/ -- CATERPILLAR INC. (NYSE: CAT) INTENDS TO INVEST APPROXIMATELY $1 BILLION IN NORTH CAROLINA TO EXPAND MANUFACTURING CAPACITY FOR PRODUCTS THAT SUPPORT ITS GROWING CAT COMPACTSM BUSINESS, HELPING CUSTOMERS GAIN FASTER ACCESS TO THE MACHINES THEY NEED TO SOLVE TOUGH JOBSITE CHALLENGES AND BUILD HOMES, INFRASTRUCTURE AND COMMUNITIES.

title: CATERPILLAR INC. ENTERS INTO AGREEMENT TO ACQUIRE FABICK CAT DEALERSHIP
text: IRVING, TEXAS, SEPT. 29, 2026 /PRNEWSWIRE/ -- CATERPILLAR INC. (NYSE: CAT) HAS ENTERED INTO AN AGREEMENT TO ACQUIRE JOHN FABICK TRACTOR COMPANY (FABICK), A LONG-STANDING CAT® DEALER WITH MORE THAN 100 YEARS OF TRUSTED SERVICE AND CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIPS ACROSS PORTIONS OF MISSOURI, ILLINOIS, THE ENTIRE STATE OF WISCONSIN AND THE UPPER PENINSULA OF MICHIGAN.

title: LUCK STONE BUILDS ON AUTONOMOUS HAULING SUCCESS WITH CATERPILLAR
text: MORE THAN 3.5 MILLION TONS HAULED AUTONOMOUSLY IN 18-MONTH PILOT DRIVES EXPANSION TO TWO ADDITIONAL LUCK STONE QUARRIES TO ENHANCE SAFETY, CONSISTENCY AND NEW OPPORTUNITIES FOR ASSOCIATES. QUARRY AUTOMATION GAINS MOMENTUM WITH FIRST-EVER DEPLOYMENT OF AUTONOMOUS HAULAGE SOLUTION ON A CAT® 775 IRVING, TEXAS, SEPT.

title: CATERPILLAR AND FIELDAI ADVANCE AI-POWERED INDUSTRIAL INNOVATION
text: LEVERAGING ROBOTICS, DIGITAL TWINS AND NVIDIA TECHNOLOGIES, THE COLLABORATION HELPS CREATE SAFER, SMARTER AND MORE PRODUCTIVE OPERATIONS IRVING, TEXAS, SEPT. 2, 2026 /PRNEWSWIRE/ -- AS INDUSTRIES FACE GROWING LABOR SHORTAGES AND INCREASING PRODUCTIVITY DEMANDS, CATERPILLAR INC. (NYSE: CAT) IS COLLABORATING WITH FIELDAI TO ADVANCE PHYSICAL AI, AUTONOMY AND ROBOTICS THAT HELP JOBSITES AND FACTORIES OPERATE SAFER AND MORE EFFICIENTLY.
